answer: The jetty receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 43 aliases trips the duplicate check at the juniper gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a garden seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
